title_en: No Waiter Comes Unless You Do This 🔔 #shorts
description_en: Korean restaurants don't come to you — you call, or you press the bell on the table. Learn 저기요 (excuse me), 띵동 (ding dong) and 이모 (auntie). Stock footage: Pexels (free license)
hook_en: No waiter is coming. Now what?
hook_vi: Không có bồi bàn đến. Giờ sao?
hook_ar: لا يأتي أي نادل. ماذا الآن؟
hook_fil: Walang dumarating na waiter. Anong gagawin?
hook_hi: कोई वेटर नहीं आ रहा। अब क्या करें?
hook_voice: No waiter is coming. Now what?

hook_voice_parts.text: No waiter is coming. Now what?

scenes.en: You just call out. Not rude here.
scenes.vi: Cứ gọi lớn. Không bất lịch sự ở đây.
scenes.id: Panggil saja. Tidak kasar di sini.
scenes.es: Solo llamas. Aquí no es de mala educación.
scenes.pt: Você só chama. Aqui não é falta de educação.
scenes.fil: Tatawag ka lang. Hindi bastos dito.
scenes.hi: आप बस आवाज़ लगाते हैं। यहाँ यह असभ्य नहीं है।
scenes.voice: 저기요. You just call out. Jeogiyo. It is not rude here.

voice_parts.text: You just call out. Jeogiyo. It is not rude here.

scenes.en: Or press the bell on the table.
scenes.vi: Hoặc bấm chuông trên bàn. Ding dong.
scenes.id: Atau tekan bel di meja. Ding dong.
scenes.es: O pulsa el timbre de la mesa.
scenes.pt: Ou aperte a campainha da mesa.
scenes.fil: O pindutin ang bell sa mesa.
scenes.hi: या मेज़ पर लगी घंटी दबाइए।
scenes.voice: 띵동. Or press the little bell on the table. Ding dong. Someone comes.

voice_parts.text: Or press the little bell on the table. Ding dong. Someone comes.

scenes.vi: Khách quen gọi nhân viên là "dì".
scenes.es: Los habituales llaman «tía» a la mesera.
scenes.pt: Os clientes fiéis chamam a atendente de «tia».
scenes.fil: Tinatawag ng suki ang server na «auntie».
scenes.hi: नियमित ग्राहक वेट्रेस को «आंटी» कहते हैं।
scenes.voice: 이모. And regulars call the server Imo. Auntie. She answers.

voice_parts.text: And regulars call the server Imo. Auntie. She answers.

cta.vi: Vậy bạn sẽ gọi thế nào? 👇
